item.title: Catholics to shell out more cash for fish as seafood prices bloat this season of Lent
item.description: During Lent, many Catholics are opting for fish instead of meat, resulting in a boost in business for local seafood restaurants, though higher seafood prices are causing some restaurants to adjust their menus and prices.

item.title: 'Now is when the big fight begins': Freed from I.C.E. detention, CNY couple back on road to legal status
item.description: An immigrant couple from Cuba, Alex González and Yan Vázquez, were released from the Buffalo Federal Detention Facility after activists and colleagues from their labor unions raised money to pay their bonds, while their cases for permanent asylum are still pending.
